arguments.lyrics:
[Intro - 4 bars, instrumental, no vocals, no count-in]

[Verse 1 - 4 bars, sung]
Apple, apple!
Here is an apple.
Apple, apple!
I see an apple.

[Chorus - 8 bars, sung]
Apple, apple!
Banana, banana!
Apple, apple!
Banana, banana!
Apple, apple!
Sing along with me.
Banana, banana!
Sing and clap with me!

[Verse 2 - 4 bars, sung, no instrumental gap]
Banana, banana!
Here is a banana.
Banana, banana!
I see a banana.

[Chorus - 8 bars, sung]
Apple, apple!
Banana, banana!
Apple, apple!
Banana, banana!
Apple, apple!
Sing along with me.
Banana, banana!
Sing and clap with me!

[Bridge - 4 bars, sung]
Apple, apple!
Can you say apple?
Banana, banana!
Can you say banana?

[Final Chorus - 8 bars, sung]
Apple, apple!
Banana, banana!
Apple, apple!
Banana, banana!
Apple, apple!
Sing along with me.
Banana, banana!
Sing and clap with me!

[Outro - 2 bars, sung]
Apple, banana!
Bye-bye, bye-bye!

[End - one final chord, stop]
arguments.style: Stay very close to the source song: preserve its melody, sung phrasing, tempo and upbeat groove. Keep the same warm cheerful boy-like lead vocal character and natural clear English. Playful light kids funk-pop with springy bass, clean rhythmic guitar and crisp soft claps. Keep the catchy Apple and Banana sections recognizable. Make only small polish changes: clear vocal, tight transitions, short breath gaps, concise natural ending. No added instrumental section.
arguments.negative_style: long instrumental break, long intro, changed melody, abrupt cutoff, operatic vocals, exaggerated pitch shifting, unintelligible words
